newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Investments changes fund disclosure.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Investments changes fund disclosure.

text.p: Mutual fund giant Fidelity Investments said on Wednesday that it will broaden its portfolio information available to mutual fund shareholders and investment advisors, but will change how it reports each fund's top 10 holdings.

Fidelity, however, will change the release of information about the top 10 holdings in each fund's portfolio by reporting the holdings 15 days after the end of each quarter. Currently, top 10 holdings are published approximately 45 days after each month-end.

"Releasing our top holdings on a quarterly basis will ensure that our investment in research is put to use solely for the benefit of our fund shareholders," William Hayes, chief operating officer for equities investments said in a statement.

Beginning in July, Fidelity's fund performance guides and its Web site will offer expanded disclosure, regarding aggregate portfolio information such as market capitalization data and valuation ratios quarterly and risk-return measures, said Fidelity, which manages $511.9 billion.
Also, written summaries of a fund's quarterly performance will be included in the fund performance guides.
Fidelity provides information on its mutual funds via telephone, an internet site at www.fidelity.com, and semiannual and annual fund shareholder reports, the firm said.
